in_sanskrit.name: विकाश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: विज्ञानमय (vijñānamaya) - having the nature of knowledge; विद्यामय (vidyāmaya) - having the nature of education; ज्ञानमय (jñānamaya) - having the nature of consciousness or awareness

in_hindi.name: बिकाश
in_hindi.meaning: विज्ञान, प्रज्ञा, बुद्धि (vijñāna, prajñā, buddhi) - knowledge, wisdom, intelligence
in_hindi.long_meaning: विज्ञानात्मक (vijñānātmaka) - having the nature of knowledge; विद्यात्मक (vidyātmaka) - having the nature of education; ज्ञानात्मक (jñānātmaka) - having the nature of consciousness or awareness

in_tamil.name: விகாச
in_tamil.meaning: விஜ்ஞானம, அறிவின்சை, பதிவு (vijjānam, aṟivinçai, pathivu) - knowledge, wisdom, intelligence

in_telugu.name: వికాశ
in_telugu.meaning: జ్ఞాన, ప్రజ్ఞా, బుద్ధి (jñāna, prajñā, buddhi) - knowledge, wisdom, intelligence

in_marathi.name: Bikash
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bikash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bikash is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'bikas' which means to cause to grow or develop. In Hindu mythology, Bikash is the name of a sage or a wise man. The name Bikash symbolizes knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment.
